en_title: Nvidia Reportedly Uninterested in Bringing Jensen Huang Back as CEO
cn_title: 据报道，Nvidia无意让黄仁勋重任首席执行官
opus_summary: 据CNBC援引知情人士报道，英伟达董事会没有考虑让已辞职的黄仁勋复任首席执行官，而是专注于对其与一名女子关系的调查。此前有报道称，黄仁勋的支持者组建了推动其回归的「作战室」；美国总统特朗普表示，他不介意黄仁勋复职。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia is reportedly not entertaining the idea of bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO following rumors that his allies had established a "war room" to push for his reinstatement.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，在有传闻称黄仁勋的盟友成立了一个「作战室」，推动他复职后，Nvidia并未考虑让他重任首席执行官。

paragraphs.en: The latest turn in the tech giant's whirlwind week arrived yesterday, when the Financial Times reported that the company's ex-boss had supported efforts from his friends in Silicon Valley to see him brought back into the fold . One source said these allies had assembled a "war room" to lay the foundation for his return, but it now seems those efforts may have been for naught.
paragraphs.cn: 这家科技巨头动荡一周的最新进展出现在昨天，当时《Financial Times》报道称，该公司前任掌门人支持他在硅谷的朋友为促成他回归公司所做的努力。一名消息人士称，这些盟友组建了一个「作战室」，为他的回归打下基础，但现在看来，这些努力可能已经白费。

paragraphs.en: The Nvidia board of directors is not considering reinstating Huang as CEO after he resigned from his position Thursday, November 12, one source told CNBC . Instead, company leadership is focused on the ongoing investigation launched after Huang confirmed he had an affair with a woman whom members of the U.S. government believed to be a Chinese spy on November 8.
paragraphs.cn: 一名消息人士告诉CNBC，在黄仁勋于11月12日周四辞去职务后，Nvidia董事会并未考虑让他复任首席执行官。相反，公司领导层正将注意力集中在一项正在进行的调查上。这项调查是在黄仁勋于11月8日证实自己与一名女性有婚外情后启动的，美国政府的一些成员认为这名女性是中国间谍。

paragraphs.en: The report states Nvidia hired law firm Wachtell Lipton to look into his relationship with the individual and how it may have compromised company secrets and/or national security. A message from the board added it had "no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised" when announcing the investigation last week.
paragraphs.cn: 报道称，Nvidia聘请律师事务所Wachtell Lipton调查他与这名女性的关系，以及这段关系可能如何危及公司机密和／或国家安全。董事会在上周宣布调查时还在一份声明中表示，「没有理由相信国家安全或Nvidia机密受到了损害」。

paragraphs.en: One of the supposed goals of Huang's secret war room of Silicon Valley supporters was to gain White House support for the reinstatement – and it's a plan that seems to have panned out. U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters today (via Bloomberg ) that he "would not mind" seeing the embattled tech leader return.
paragraphs.cn: 据称，黄仁勋的硅谷支持者所组成的秘密作战室的目标之一，是争取白宫支持他复职——而这一计划似乎奏效了。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普今天告诉记者（据彭博社报道），他「不介意」看到这位陷入困境的科技领袖回归。

paragraphs.en: "I would not mind. I would not mind that," he said. "I threw out the name of Tim Cook , but I would say that Jensen's reinstatement… I think he learned a big lesson. I guess maybe one lesson's more important than another, but I would certainly not mind seeing that."
paragraphs.cn: 「我不介意。我不介意那样，」他说。「我提过蒂姆·库克的名字，但我会说，黄仁勋复职……我认为他吸取了一个重大教训。我想也许一个教训比另一个更重要，但我当然不介意看到那样的结果。」

paragraphs.en: Huang and Nvidia are now trying to pick up the pieces after the investigation began last week. The story so far has seen tech billionaire Elon Musk publicly back Huang , with some Nvidia employees saying they'd like him reinstated, too. Additional reports have said the former CEO had additional affairs with not one but two of his subordinates .
paragraphs.cn: 在调查上周开始后，黄仁勋和Nvidia现在正努力收拾残局。事件发展至今，科技界亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克已公开支持黄仁勋，一些Nvidia员工也表示希望他复职。另有报道称，这位前首席执行官还与他的下属有染，而且不止一人，而是两人。
